name: The gray-clad rider
summary: A dusty horseman in gray who asks for water and gives news; in truth a Federal scout, which Farquhar never learns.
personality: Ceremonious, patient; tells a civilian exactly enough to lead him on.

start.public_state: A dusty gray-clad soldier on a horse.
start.inner_state: Setting a trap for a civilian who may rise to the bait.
